claims.object_text: epilepsy of infancy with migrating focal seizures (EIMFS)
claims.quote: The most frequently implicated genes were KCNT1 (36/135, 27%) and SCN2A (10/135, 7%).
Median age at seizure onset was 4 weeks, with earlier onset in the SCN2A, KCNQ2, and BRAT1 groups.
Mosaicism occurred in 2 probands (SCN2A, GABRB3) and 3 unaffected mothers (KCNT1).
